events.title: Break the Press, Attack the Space

content.title: Break the Press, Attack the Space
content.objective: Play through the first line of pressure, connect through midfield and attack with purpose before the opposition recovers.

content.title: Arrival Rondo
instructions: Set four cones around the square. Keep five players around the outside and two in the middle. Place spare balls just outside the area.
Keep the ball moving around the outside. Defenders press as a pair and swap with the player who loses possession.
Progress to two-touch when the outside players can receive and release without losing their support angles.
coachingPoints: Scan both defenders before the pass arrives.
Show a passing angle on either side of the ball.
progressions: Award a point for a pass that splits both defenders.

content.title: Positional Play Through Thirds
instructions: Set the 12 × 20 m area and walk the group through the starting positions. Use the marked zone as the first connection point and restart from spare balls on the side.
Invite pressure on the first pass. The player beyond the first line checks their shoulder and moves as the pass travels so the ball carrier has two distinct options.
Restart from the opposite side after each block. Leave the far-side option open and let the players decide when to use it.
When a player receives between the lines, ask a third player to support beyond the ball. If that route closes, recycle and change the point of attack.
On a turnover, the closest player presses immediately and the next two players narrow their angles to close the forward pass.
Finish with a player-led recap. Ask each unit for one early cue, one support movement and one reason to recycle possession.
coachingPoints: Scan before receiving and open up to the next line.
React immediately when possession turns over.
progressions: Introduce a recovering defender on the second pass.
Limit touches once the group consistently finds the spare player.
variations: Score for receiving beyond the first line on both sides.

content.title: Half-pitch Attacking Combinations
instructions: Start attacks just inside the half. Keep one wide option and a supporting player underneath the ball on each restart.
Combine through a third player or switch to the far side. Finish the move with a runner attacking the space between defenders.
Reset from the opposite flank and repeat. Defenders can counter to the halfway line on a regain.
coachingPoints: Delay the final run until the passer can play forward.
Keep the weak-side runner connected to the goal.
progressions: Allow a recovering defender to enter on the first forward pass.

content.title: Full-pitch Defensive Organisation
instructions: Start from the opposition back line with both units in their match shape. Show the central compactness zone before the first restart.
Move as the ball travels. Press on a slow square pass and keep cover behind the first defender.
On a regain, look forward immediately. If the first option is closed, retain possession and reset the block.
coachingPoints: Keep distances between the midfield and back line short.
Use the far-side player to protect the centre.

content.title: Attacking Corner Routine
instructions: Set the corner delivery, starting positions and rest defence. Walk the first run before serving a live ball.
Start the near-side movement on the kicker’s signal. Attack the second ball as soon as the delivery clears the first defender.
Reset the defensive cover before repeating from the opposite side.
coachingPoints: Time the run to arrive with the ball.
Keep a player available for the short option and protect the counter.
progressions: Allow live defenders to track or pass on runners.

content.title: Rondos & Positional Play
content.objective: Improve passing speed, support angles and decision making under pressure before progressing into positional play.

content.title: Dynamic passing
instructions: Maintain support angles and rotate regularly.
coachingPoints: Scan before receiving; play with an open body shape.
